name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A shadcn/ui dialog built on scrollsheet instead of Radix Dialog. Same Dialog/DialogTrigger/DialogContent/DialogHeader/DialogFooter/DialogTitle/DialogDescription/DialogClose API you already know, but backed by a native <dialog> in the top layer with scrollsheet's centered presentation (zoom+fade, no travel or detents). Zero runtime dependencies beyond scrollsheet itself.
author: Ansuman Shah <https://github.com/ansumanshah>
